messages:
ashley (sec): Heads-up — after the RBAC pruning deploy this morning we’re seeing intermittent egress TLS handshakes fail in ap-south. KMS decrypt denies in the proxy logs. Can someone from infra/devops triage?
kevin (infra): I saw the spike on the egress proxy metrics, + latency. Suspect the keystore role change we pushed at 06:12 UTC. Rolling back now? :thinking_face:
irene (devops): I’m on it. Before rollback, can we confirm which service principal is hitting KMS? audit-bot, any recent decrypt deny counts?
audit-bot: KMS Decrypt Deny summary: 2026-05-18T06:15:12Z -> 2026-05-18T06:27:40Z: 143 denies from principal service/egress-proxy@redwood.internal, target key: projects/redwood/kms/keystore-edge-prod
sam (mlops): FYI traffic pattern — a few model-serving pods in ap-south burst-regen cached prefixes around 06:14, might correlate (more concurrent handshakes).
kevin (infra): Copy. Irene, quick check: are certs being rotated at the same time? certbot, anything scheduled?
certbot: No automatic cert rotation scheduled for ap-south this window. Last manual rotation was 3 days ago. However, the rotator job attempted a partial rekey at 06:10 (child job failed -> left half-chains). See log snippet below.
certbot: ```
2026-05-18T06:10:03Z rotator: start rekey for service=egress-proxy region=ap-south
2026-05-18T06:10:09Z rotator: uploaded new leaf, started chain update
2026-05-18T06:11:01Z rotator: KMS: Decrypt deny for signing-key, status=403
2026-05-18T06:11:02Z rotator: aborting rekey, leaving intermediate staged
```
ashley (sec): So two things line up: RBAC role pruning (06:12) + rotator failed (06:11) + KMS denies. My hypothesis: RBAC change removed the decrypt permission for the rotator service principal, leaving a partial chain that some clients try to use -> handshake fails.
irene (devops): Agreed. Action plan: 1) Re-add decrypt permission to rotator principal (fast) 2) Force rotator to finish a safe rekey (non-destructive) 3) Backfill audit logs for impacted sessions 4) Postmortem. Anyone object to rolling RBAC back first?
kevin (infra): I’ll reapply the previous role binding now (quick revert). Pushing terraform rollback to infra-keystore-role-binding (apply).
kevin (infra): command: ```terraform apply -target=module.kms_role_binding -var='env=prod'```
kevin (infra): applied and IAM binding restored. Waiting for propagation (~30s).
certbot: IAM binding visible. Retrying rotator finalization.
certbot: rotator run -> success: ```2026-05-18T06:16:38Z rotator: finalized chain for egress-proxy region=ap-south status=ok```
irene (devops): Restarting egress-proxy pods to pick up chain. ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/egress-proxy -n infra```
kevin (infra): Pod restarts healthy, no handshake errors reported now on live metrics. Latency back to baseline.
audit-bot: Correlation events written: KMS decrypt denies (143), RBAC change event id=rbac-20260518-0612, rotator abort event, cert finalize event. Links: https://audit.redwood/internal/events/rbac-20260518-0612
sam (mlops): Quick question — do we have any clients pinned to the old intermediate that might keep failing until TTL expiry? We should track 503s from model-serving and consider a short-lived bypass if needed.
ashley (sec): Good catch. Irene — can you add a short monitoring rule to catch persistent handshake errors for next 24h and alert channel if >10/min? Also preserve logs for the 06:10-06:20 window for compliance review.
irene (devops): Will do. I’ll add alert and export logs to secure S3 with retention tag "inc-20260518-egress-tls".
kevin (infra): Also opening a follow-up PR to add an invariant test: rotator must succeed (or roll back) when IAM changes happen in same window.
ashley (sec): Action items summarized: 1) kevin revert RBAC done 2) certbot finalized rekey 3) irene restarted pods + added alert + exported logs 4) kevin PR for guardrails 5) sam to watch client errors and report any lingering 6) security to draft incident note.
ashley (sec): One more compliance note — we need to include the audit-bot correlation link in the incident ticket and note that KMS denies were due to an RBAC change. I’ll start the incident doc.
certbot: tagging the rotator run id: rot-20260518-0610 for traceability.
audit-bot: Exported audit bundle to s3://redwood-compliance/incidents/20260518-egress-tls/audit-bundle.tar.gz
ashley (sec): Thanks everyone. Close loop after 24h observation window. :thumbsup:
